title: ‘South Park’ Creators Apologize for the Years-Long Delay of Their Kendrick Lamar Movie: ‘We Still Believe in the Project’
content:
ByJack Dunn

“South Park” co-creatorsTrey ParkerandMatt Stonehave released an official apology for delaying their mysterious film collaboration withKendrick Lamar.

“We take full responsibility for the schedule delay of this movie,” Parker and Stone said in a statement to The Ankler. “We apologize to our partners at pgLang and Paramount, and we appreciate their patience. ‘South Park’ and life’s circumstances have gotten in the way, but we still believe in the project.”

Reps for Paramount, Parker and Stone did not immediately respond toVariety’s request for comment.

The musical comedy movie, operating under the working title “Whitney Springs,” is in production at Paramount, which is also the home of “South Park.” Parker and Stone are working on the project under their Park County banner. Lamar is also producing alongside Dave Free and his pgLang company.

Early loglines stated that “Whitney Springs” follows a Black man working as a slave reenactor at a living history museum who discovers his white girlfriend’s family once owned his ancestors. The Ankler reported a slight variation on the story. The outlet claims that the film follows the Black slave reenactor as he clashes with the racist mayor of a Midwestern town, who will be played by Parker. Lamar, The Ankler said, has recorded several original songs for the project.

Parker and Stone debut “South Park” Season 29 on Sept. 16. Seasons 27 and 28 came after a two-year hiatus and shocked audiences with the inclusion of Donald Trump as a major antagonist. The show has continued to troll the president in the off season. Parker and Stone recentlychanged the name of “South Park” to “South America,”in an apparent jab at Trump for changing the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America and Lake Ontario to Lake America.
title_zh: 《南方公園》(South Park) 創作者為他們的肯德里克·拉馬(Kendrick Lamar)電影多年來的延遲道歉：‘我們仍然相信這個項目’
content_zh:
由杰克·邓恩 (Jack Dunn) 報導

《南方公園》(South Park) 的共同創作者特雷·帕克 (Trey Parker) 和馬特·史通 (Matt Stone) 對於延遲與肯德里克·拉馬爾 (Kendrick Lamar) 的神秘電影合作發表了正式道歉。

帕克和史通在給《The Ankler》的聲明中表示：“我們對這部電影的排程延遲負全責。我們向 pgLang 和派拉蒙 (Paramount) 的合作夥伴道歉，感謝他們的耐心。《南方公園》和生活中的種種情況影響了進度，但我們仍然相信這個項目。”

派拉蒙、帕克和史通的代表尚未立即回應《Variety》的評論請求。

這部音樂喜劇電影目前以工作標題“惠特尼·斯普林斯”(Whitney Springs) 進行製作，派拉蒙也是《南方公園》的母公司。帕克和史通在他們的 Park County 標籤下參與該項目。拉馬爾也與戴夫·弗里 (Dave Free) 和他的 pgLang 公司一起擔任製片。

早期的劇情簡介指出，“惠特尼·斯普林斯”講述了一位在活歷史博物館擔任奴隸重演者的黑人男子，他發現自己的白人女友的家族曾擁有他的祖先。《The Ankler》報導了該故事的輕微變化。該媒體聲稱，這部電影講述了這位黑人奴隸重演者與一位中西部城鎮的種族歧視市長之間的衝突，市長將由帕克飾演。《The Ankler》表示，拉馬爾為該項目錄製了幾首原創歌曲。

帕克和史通將於9月16日首播《南方公園》第29季。第27季和第28季在兩年 hiatus 後推出，並因唐納德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 作為主要反派的加入而震驚觀眾。該節目在休季期間持續對總統進行嘲諷。帕克和史通最近將《南方公園》的名稱改為“南美洲”(South America)，顯然是在諷刺特朗普將墨西哥灣改為美國灣，安大略湖改為美國湖。
